name: vLLM per-step inter-token latency histogram
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: inter_token_latency. One sample per streamed output event: the wall-clock gap between successive outputs, NOT divided by token count. Distinct from request_time_per_output_token_seconds and not interchangeable with it.
